body:
I am a 25 year old male with anxiety.  I have experience with shrooms, san pedro, mj and whipits.  I got layed off from my job and lost my medical insurance so I have been researching different chems and plants for the antianxiolitic effects I could get for cheap.  I made a thick joint from some dead wormwood I have in the backyard and smoked about 3/4 of it.  I feel a little high and pretty relaxed.  FYI everyone its obvious that this plant works.
